content.comment_body: Hello, Not all [product_name] extension modules can be mounted on a single DIN rail, so I am looking for a way to connect them with a cable. I found this product: [url] but it is quite expensive and rather long (2 meters). Are there any alternative solutions? Thanks.

[product_name] extension cable for [version_no] setup, 2.0 meters. This cable is specifically for [version_no], not for [product_name]. For [product_name], no such cable is available for this purpose. If you need to add more expansion modules on a second rail, your only option is to use a second [product_name] device on that rail.
Check out this video from [company_name]: 2 Line Configuration

analysis.insight_summary: The user is facing a challenge with mounting [product_name] expansion modules on a single DIN rail, as they do not all fit together. The only cable found for connecting modules across separate rails is intended for a different [company_name] product and is costly, with no suitable cable available for [product_name]. This severely limits flexible installation options for users who need to distribute modules on multiple rails.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for a cost-effective and compatible extension cable to safely and conveniently connect [product_name] expansion modules across separate DIN rails.
